cohort.outlier_policy: Keep all reliable finite nonnegative published yields; no outcome-based trimming
cohort.missing_coordinates: Keep only if Phase1 reliable_unit; no coordinates are required as model features

F1.water_policy: GGE 2016/2017 marked UNKNOWN_V1 due documented ambiguity; preserve original treatment for grouping, never import corrected GitHub labels

F2.legality_gate: Every site-year has actual recorded heading after cutoff, with earliest heading >=123 DOY; weather end <=90/91 DOY. Never use heading or harvest variables as model inputs; no full-season weather; no sowing-date reconstruction.

sensitivity.reason: Predefined sensitivity to site-specific artificial-inoculation regime; no claim to isolate inoculation causally

hyperparameter_selection: NONE; fixed before training, no early stopping or test eval_set; inner CV NOT APPLICABLE

MixedLM.fixed: release year + management (+ four weather features for F2); cultivar ID not fixed effect
MixedLM.random: site-year intercept and nested Block intercept
MixedLM.prediction: fixed effects only for all test strategies; no test random effect estimation

bootstrap.interval: percentile 95%; descriptive conditional uncertainty, only 5 sites and 3 years
